key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Sudden or gradual, can be paroxysmal (comes and goes). LOCATION: Chest (palpitations), generalized. DURATION: Variable (minutes to persistent). CHARACTER: IRREGULAR, RAPID palpitations, "fluttering" or "quivering" in chest. AGGRAVATING: Caffeine, alcohol, stress, dehydration. RELIEVING: Rest, sometimes spontaneous. TIMING: Paroxysmal (episodic) or persistent. SEVERITY: Variable discomfort. KEY POSITIVES: Dyspnea, lightheadedness, fatigue, irregularly irregular pulse on exam, chest discomfort. KEY NEGATIVES: NOT regular rapid heartbeat (SVT), NOT slow irregular (heart block).
